AIR

Keep the oxygen plant watered (hold E); replant when withered. Suit reserve covers bad air, then breath collapses.
Airlock: E on the cycle panel — never open both doors. Surface air is thin.

BUILD

B build mode   1 gas pump   2 pipe   3 craft table   4 generator   5 battery
6 cable   7 breaker   8 liquid pump   9 liquid pipe   0 conveyor
LMB place   R rotate   X remove (refund)   E bolt next add-on   RMB exit
, . craft-table tier / conveyor subtype   cyan hologram = valid, red = blocked; aim at the ceiling to roof-mount

PUMPS & PIPES

E pump monitor = switch (needs a powered cable path)   E side hatch = swap filter
O bolt outlet kit   I bolt intake upgrade (aimed at the pump)
hold E on a cracked pipe = repair   G reinforce collar (raises tier). Over 20% load cracks slowly; over 75% bursts.

POWER

Cable must touch the device base. E generator = load briquette   E tripped breaker = reset
Cables overload like pipes: hold E repair, G sleeve. Scarce watts go to high-priority chipped devices first.
Mining drill draws 150 W continuous while spinning — sleeve the feeder to T2 (200 W) before stacking other loads on T1.
Ore refinery draws 100 W while cabled — sleeve to T2 recommended. Table press remains the early/manual fallback.
ARK-03 turbine: repair → control chip → sleeve export + outdoor pylons to T3 (500 W) → briquettes → start. Weak pylons short under the push; station feed climbs when the line holds.

LIQUID & CONVEYOR

Liquid pump: free-standing, needs power + a source tank; pipes feed the plant water port.
Conveyor belts need modest power   E loader = deposit briquettes / scrap; unloader feeds generator / crate.
Mining drill (T5, 150 W): E place from pack · faces diggable cells · output → loader or ground · E bolt hardened bit.
Ore refinery (T3, 100 W): E place · ore scrap in (player / unloader / hopper) → 4 briquettes per 2 ore over ~5 s · loader takes output · E bolt crusher.

LUCID

E on a pump side socket (or L aimed) = seat / pull control link   E wall monitor = link panel
Wall monitor: 1-9 switch linked unit   panel: click buttons, 1-9 toggle, Esc/E close
Orb: E wake on the shelf → C panel anywhere. Bolt arm / dig-laser / legs on its stubs; legs add Hold / Recall / Scout.
Torso: craft chassis → E seat the orb (E again unseats). Control room: place console → E dock LUCID; chips (E on chip bay) unlock trim / priority.

IMP CREW

Hold E on a dormant imp = jump-start (needs breathable air); Q carry it somewhere breathable.
E awake imp = next job: follow · wander · tend plant · labor (craft table) · haul (scrap → crate). Jobs stay in the imp's own zone.
Remote (LUCID reachable): Tab pick imp, Shift+1-5 or F T L H W = FOLLOW / TEND / LABOR / HAUL / WANDER. Control room: ALL → job buttons.
Every imp breathes ~1/4 of you; in thin air it slows, then powers down until you fix the air and jump-start it.

ARKS & DIGGING

ARK-01: hatch → restore power junction → close gate breaker → bulkhead. Claim the omni-tool (faster F, enables V).
ARK-02 (west, further out): dig the soil-packed rails with V. ARK-03 (furthest, past ARK-01): seat 2 batteries, sleeve the ram feeder to T3, cycle the blast door. Clear the dig-laser cave-in → scan the drill head → craft a mining drill (T5) → E place; cable 150 W; faces ore/berm. Scan the briquette die → table press (2→3) or craft ore refinery (2→4, 100 W). Restart the hall turbine (repair kit, control chip, T3 export, briquettes) and repair/sleeve the outdoor pylons to T3 — station feed gains bulk watts when the line holds. Dug pockets hold their own (bad) air: E on the pocket floor hangs a seal hatch / curtain, scrubbers clean it.
